verses.text: This is the vision that Isaiah son of Amoz saw about Judah and Jerusalem, during the time when Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah were kings of Judah.
Listen, heavens! Pay attention, earth! For the LORD has spoken: "I raised children and brought them up, but they have turned against me.
The ox knows its owner, and the donkey knows where its master feeds it. But Israel does not know me. My people do not understand."

How terrible for this sinful nation, a people weighed down with guilt, children of evildoers, children who do what is corrupt! They have turned away from the LORD. They have rejected the Holy One of Israel. They have turned their backs on him.
Why do you want to be beaten more? Why do you keep rebelling? Your whole head is sick, and your whole heart is weak.
From the bottom of your feet to the top of your head, there is nothing healthy. There are only wounds, bruises, and open sores. They have not been cleaned, bandaged, or soothed with oil.
Your country is ruined. Your cities are burned with fire. Strangers are eating up your land right in front of you. It is ruined, as if strangers had destroyed it.
The daughter of Zion is left like a shelter in a vineyard, like a hut in a melon field, like a city under attack.
If the LORD of Armies had not left us a few survivors, we would have been like Sodom. We would have been like Gomorrah.
Listen to the word of the LORD, you rulers of Sodom! Listen to the teaching of our God, you people of Gomorrah!

"What are all your many sacrifices to me?" says the LORD. "I have had more than enough of burnt offerings of rams and the fat of fattened animals. I do not delight in the blood of bulls, lambs, or goats.
When you come to meet with me, who asked you to do this, to trample through my courts?
Stop bringing meaningless offerings. Your incense is disgusting to me. New Moons, Sabbaths, and special meetings, I cannot stand your evil gatherings.
I hate your New Moon festivals and your appointed feasts. They have become a burden to me. I am tired of carrying them.
When you lift up your hands to pray, I will hide my eyes from you. Even when you pray many prayers, I will not listen. Your hands are full of blood.
Wash yourselves. Make yourselves clean. Take your evil deeds out of my sight. Stop doing evil.
Learn to do good. Seek justice. Help those who are treated cruelly. Defend the orphans. Stand up for the widows."
"Come now, let us talk this over," says the LORD. "Even though your sins are like scarlet, they will be as white as snow. Even though they are red like crimson, they will be like wool.
If you are willing and obey, you will eat the good things of the land.
But if you refuse and rebel, you will be destroyed by the sword. For the mouth of the LORD has spoken."
See how the faithful city has become like a prostitute! She was once full of justice. Righteousness lived in her, but now murderers live there.
Your silver has become worthless metal. Your wine is mixed with water.
Your leaders are rebels and friends of thieves. They all love bribes and chase after gifts. They do not defend the orphans, and the widows' cases never come before them.
So the Lord GOD of Armies, the Mighty One of Israel, says: "I will get relief from my enemies and pay back those who oppose me.
I will turn my hand against you. I will completely burn away your worthless metal and remove all your impurities.
I will give you judges again, like you had at first, and advisers like you had in the beginning. After that you will be called 'The City of Righteousness, the Faithful City.'"
Zion will be rescued by justice, and those who turn back to her by righteousness.
But rebels and sinners will be destroyed together, and those who turn away from the LORD will perish.
You will be ashamed of the sacred oak trees you loved, and you will be embarrassed because of the gardens you chose.
You will be like an oak tree with dying leaves, and like a garden that has no water.
The strong will become like dry straw, and their work like a spark. Both will burn together, and no one will put out the fire.
